d7:hondanews-ca-2024-hatch-specs.title: 2024 Honda Civic Hatchback Specifications (April 4, 2024)
d7:hondanews-ca-2024-hatch-specs.applicability: 2024 Civic Hatchback Sport and Sport Touring, Canada

candidates.how_to_measure: Coast-down test (two directions, calm day, known mass) fitted to F = A + B v + C v^2 gives CdA; or EPA coast-down target coefficients if found.
candidates.notes: A search summary mentioned '0.29' for the 2024 hatch without a source page; not recorded. Press kit: Careful tuning of its design has given the 11th-generation Civic Hatchback outstanding aerodynamic performance, including a drag reduction of approximately 3 percent.

candidates.evidence: Careful tuning of its design has given the 11th-generation Civic Hatchback outstanding aerodynamic performance, including a drag reduction of approximately 3 percent.

candidates.value: no separate wing; spoiler integrated into the resin hatch/tailgate trailing edge
candidates.locator: Exterior Design 'What's New' and body text
candidates.evidence: Distinct styling cues include a honeycomb grille, a unique integrated rear spoiler, exhaust finishers and standard alloy wheels … The 2022 Civic Hatchback eliminates the previous rear spoiler, giving the rear end a much cleaner and more integrated appearance without any loss of visibility.
candidates.notes: HPD accessory tailgate spoiler is an option, not stock. 2024 Canadian spec lists no spoiler item.

candidates.value: floor undercover present (described for noise absorption); extent not published
candidates.evidence: Road noise is reduced through the use of a noise-absorbing floor undercover and rear inner fender liner, plus noise-absorbing carpeting.
candidates.how_to_measure: Underbody photos on a lift showing engine undercover and floor panels.

candidates.value: reshaped front bumper corners; larger A-pillar drip molding; vortex generators under mirror housings; optimised tailgate trailing-edge height; taillights shaped to reduce trailing vortex
candidates.evidence: In front, a new and better bumper corner shape was used … airflow turbulence under the door mirror was reduced by adding small vortex generators to the underside of the door mirror housing. In the rear, the height of the trailing edge of the tailgate is optimized to reduce downwash.

candidates.how_to_measure: Photograph the car head-on with a long lens next to a scale bar and integrate the silhouette by script.
candidates.notes: Not published. Frontal-area estimate from width x height is derived in scripts/derivations/brakes_aero.py (aero.frontal_area_est).
